title: About Me
bio:
Hello! My name is Anthony, and I'm a current M.S. Robo student at Georgia Tech researching powered prostheses. I completed my B.S. in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, and I was born and raised in the Bay Area, CA!
As a robotics engineer, I hope to contribute to a safer and more accessible future for the world.

Come check out some of the stuff I've done, and please feel free to reach out about any inquiries whatsoever. Would love to chat!
